const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""BEHAVIOR-1K stacking_wood episode controller.
+
+Uses only the standard Robot service, camera frames, and robot proprioception.
+The command-line helpers below permit visually guided operation of the single
+episode while retaining an executable record of each control primitive.
+"""
+import json
+import math
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+HEAD = "robot_r1:zed_link:Camera:0"
+
+
+def action_from_obs(obs, spec):
+    names = obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+    vals = obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]
+    q = dict(zip(names, vals))
+    action = np.zeros(25, dtype=np.float32)
+    for i, name in enumerate(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["layout"][3:], 3):
+        if name.startswith("trunk_"):
+            action[i] = q[f"torso_joint{int(name[-1]) + 1}"]
+        elif name.startswith("arm_left_"):
+            action[i] = q[f"left_arm_joint{int(name[-1]) + 1}"]
+        elif name.startswith("arm_right_"):
+            action[i] = q[f"right_arm_joint{int(name[-1]) + 1}"]
+        elif name.startswith("gripper_"):
+            action[i] = 0.07
+    return action
+
+
+def save_obs(obs, label):
+    folder = OUT / label
+    obs.save(str(folder))
+    base = obs.group("base_pose", now=True)
+    print(label, "base", np.round(base, 3), "done", obs.meta.get("done"),
+          "time_left", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
+    return folder
+
+
+def scan():
+    r = Robot()
+    spec = r.spec()
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=[HEAD], depth=True)
+    save_obs(obs, "scan_00")
+    action = action_from_obs(obs, spec)
+    for i in range(1, 9):
+        turn = action.copy()
+        turn[2] = math.pi / 120  # thirty 30-Hz steps per 45 degrees
+        res = r.submit("joint_position", np.stack([turn, turn]), dt=0.5,
+                       interpolate="hold", cameras=[HEAD], depth=True,
+                       video="none", note=f"scan turn {i} of 8")
+        save_obs(res, f"scan_{i:02d}")
+        if res.done:
+            break
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "scan":
+        scan()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

"""BEHAVIOR-1K stacking_wood episode controller.

Uses only the standard Robot service, camera frames, and robot proprioception.
The command-line helpers below permit visually guided operation of the single
episode while retaining an executable record of each control primitive.
"""
import json
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path("/app/output")
HEAD = "robot_r1:zed_link:Camera:0"


def action_from_obs(obs, spec):
    names = obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
    vals = obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]
    q = dict(zip(names, vals))
    action = np.zeros(25, dtype=np.float32)
    for i, name in enumerate(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["layout"][3:], 3):
        if name.startswith("trunk_"):
            action[i] = q[f"torso_joint{int(name[-1]) + 1}"]
        elif name.startswith("arm_left_"):
            action[i] = q[f"left_arm_joint{int(name[-1]) + 1}"]
        elif name.startswith("arm_right_"):
            action[i] = q[f"right_arm_joint{int(name[-1]) + 1}"]
        elif name.startswith("gripper_"):
            action[i] = 0.07
    return action


def save_obs(obs, label):
    folder = OUT / label
    obs.save(str(folder))
    base = obs.group("base_pose", now=True)
    print(label, "base", np.round(base, 3), "done", obs.meta.get("done"),
          "time_left", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
    return folder


def scan():
    r = Robot()
    spec = r.spec()
    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=[HEAD], depth=True)
    save_obs(obs, "scan_00")
    action = action_from_obs(obs, spec)
    for i in range(1, 9):
        turn = action.copy()
        turn[2] = math.pi / 120  # thirty 30-Hz steps per 45 degrees
        res = r.submit("joint_position", np.stack([turn, turn]), dt=0.5,
                       interpolate="hold", cameras=[HEAD], depth=True,
                       video="none", note=f"scan turn {i} of 8")
        save_obs(res, f"scan_{i:02d}")
        if res.done:
            break


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "scan":
        scan()

"""BEHAVIOR-1K stacking_wood episode controller.

Uses only the standard Robot service, camera frames, and robot proprioception.
The command-line helpers below permit visually guided operation of the single
episode while retaining an executable record of each control primitive.
"""
import json
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path("/app/output")
HEAD = "robot_r1:zed_link:Camera:0"


def action_from_obs(obs, spec):
    names = obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
    vals = obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]
    q = dict(zip(names, vals))
    action = np.zeros(25, dtype=np.float32)
    for i, name in enumerate(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["layout"][3:], 3):
        if name.startswith("trunk_"):
            action[i] = q[f"torso_joint{int(name[-1]) + 1}"]
        elif name.startswith("arm_left_"):
            action[i] = q[f"left_arm_joint{int(name[-1]) + 1}"]
        elif name.startswith("arm_right_"):
            action[i] = q[f"right_arm_joint{int(name[-1]) + 1}"]
        elif name.startswith("gripper_"):
            action[i] = 0.07
    return action


def save_obs(obs, label):
    folder = OUT / label
    obs.save(str(folder))
    base = obs.group("base_pose", now=True)
    print(label, "base", np.round(base, 3), "done", obs.meta.get("done"),
          "time_left", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
    return folder


def scan():
    r = Robot()
    spec = r.spec()
    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=[HEAD], depth=True)
    save_obs(obs, "scan_00")
    action = action_from_obs(obs, spec)
    for i in range(1, 9):
        turn = action.copy()
        turn[2] = math.pi / 120  # thirty 30-Hz steps per 45 degrees
        res = r.submit("joint_position", np.stack([turn, turn]), dt=0.5,
                       interpolate="hold", cameras=[HEAD], depth=True,
                       video="none", note=f"scan turn {i} of 8")
        save_obs(res, f"scan_{i:02d}")
        if res.done:
            break


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "scan":
        scan()

 m=json.load(open(f/'meta.json'));d=np.load(f/f'last_depth_{head}.npy');im=np.array(Image.open(f/'last'/f'{head}.jpg')).astype(float)
 E=np.array(m['cameras'][head]['extrinsic_cv']);K=np.array(m['cameras'][head]['intrinsic_cv']);v,u=np.indices(d.shape);z=d

 world=(cam-E[:,3])@E[:,:3]

 mask=(z>0)&(world[:,:,2]>.035)&(world[:,:,2]<.17)&(r-g>10)&(g-b>2)&(r<200)&(world[:,:,0]>-23.4)&(world[:,:,0]<-14)&(world[:,:,1]>8)&(world[:,:,1]<18)

 for p in pts: points.append((name,*p))
points=np.array(points,dtype=object)
scale=90;W=1100;H=1000

# x world -24..-12 left to right, y 8..18 bottom to top
for row in points:
 name,x,y,z=row;x=float(x);y=float(y)
 px=int((x+24)*scale);py=int((18-y)*scale)
 if 0<=px<W and 0<=py<H:draw.ellipse((px-2,py-2,px+2,py+2),fill='#8b4513')
for x in range(-24,-11,2):

for y in range(8,19,2):
 py=int((18-y)*scale);draw.line((0,py,W,py),fill='#aaaaaa');draw.text((2,py+2),str(y),fill='black')
out.save('/app/output/log_map.png')
